interpretation: People in B–B pairs never appear in training labels; test dates were exposed before. Day-block intervals per partition describe day-to-day variation; partitions are not independent replications.

protocol.features: frozen T20 7d banks; network features use every participant's past contacts (no labels)
protocol.fold_gate: drop a fold for this partition if train, validation or a test population lacks 20 rows per class
protocol.partition: group = sha256('T38|salt|dataset|participant') mod 2; A=0 trains, B=1 is held out

references.xgboost_seen: T35 7d XGBoost trained on all participants

protocol.threshold: maximum validation F1 on A–A validation pairs
protocol.train_population: A–A pairs at the fold's train and validation times
